metadata.name: Read a table on a web page
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “Read a table on a web page” in Recued. Read a table on a page as columns and rows of text, without the HTML around it: the table a CSS selector or ref names, or the page's first. Works for HTML tables and ARIA grids, up to 500 rows. To click something in a row, read that part of the page for its refs. Opens the page first if no tab shows it.

ref.help: The ref of the table or of something in it, such as e12, from the latest inspection of this page. Leave it empty when passing a selector.
ref.label: Element

page.help: The page's address, such as https://example.com/orders, whether a tab shows it or not: with none showing it, the page is opened in a new tab first, which asks you unless allowed on that site. Or a page handle a listing, an opening, a read or an action answered, copied exactly.
page.label: Page

selector.help: A CSS selector for the table, or for the part of the page it is in, such as #invoices or main. Leave it empty to read the first table, or to name it by ref.
selector.label: Table
